Slate-grey chitin, ivory spikes, four articulated legs, big muted VIOLET back sac, small amber eyes and lime-gold acid throat only at FRONT. FIXED elevated 3/4 camera. EXACTLY 6 equal columns by 5 equal rows (30 sprites). Row 1 SOUTH front toward viewer. Row 2 SOUTHEAST head points LOWER RIGHT. Row 3 EAST head points SCREEN RIGHT, side profile. Row 4 NORTHEAST head points UPPER RIGHT away, rear 3/4 back visible, face hidden. Row 5 NORTH points straight up away, direct BACK with violet sac dominant, no front eyes or open mouth pointing at viewer. Anatomical turnarounds, never rotate a sprite in-plane. In each row columns 1-4 are 4 different alternating leg phases of a walk cycle, no shell sliding, steady body height. Column 5 throat charging, head lifted. Column 6 acid spit release IN ROW DIRECTION; tiny acid droplets very close to mouth and wholly inside the cell. Keep exact body identity and silhouette size. Every entire sprite fits inside central 60% of cell width and height with generous 20% transparent gutters on all sides. No overlapping cells, stable feet baseline. Crisp chunky pixel shading and dark clean outline matching reference. Genuine transparent RGBA. NO shadows, NO background glow or backdrop, NO red/green stray outline artifacts, NO text, NO grid or labels.
